scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with tall buildings and a person riding a bicycle along the sidewalk. The street has a bus lane and a crosswalk. There are several cars and motorcycles driving down the street. The sky is blue with some clouds. The sun is shining brightly. The buildings have many windows and balconies. The street is lined with trees and bushes. The sidewalk is made of concrete and has a curb. The person on the bicycle is wearing a backpack and has short hair. They are riding towards the right side of the image.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large white building on the left has a curved corner and balconies on each floor. The red building on the right has a flat roof and rectangular windows. The black car is parked on the right side of the street. The motorcycle is driving away from the camera. The tree in the middle of the street has no leaves.
scene_analysis.materials: The white building has a smooth stone facade with decorative elements. The red building has a rough texture and a flat roof. The black car has tinted windows. The motorcycle has a sleek design.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are no benches or tables outside the buildings. There are no trash cans or recycling bins.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are small trees and bushes along the sidewalk. There are no flowers or plants.
scene_analysis.signage: There are no signs or advertisements visible.
